summary: The rewrite handles the large literal and passes the focused suite. It changes the prior transformation for a complete SQL statement containing an odd run of apostrophes inside a double quoted identifier, contrary to the requested compatibility behavior.

findings.claim: The scanner always consumes adjacent apostrophes as an escape, even when no later closing apostrophe exists. The previous regex backtracked and used the first as a closing quote, so this changes trimming in complete statements with apostrophes inside double quoted identifiers; double quotes are specified not to affect single quote recognition.
findings.repro: Input: SELECT "a 'b  ''" FROM t. Current trimLiterals output: SELECT "a 'b  ''" FROM t. Baseline output: SELECT "a 'b''" FROM t.
